title: Promotions & Discounts
description: Learn how to create promotional campaigns, flash sales, seasonal discounts, and special offers to boost sales.
content:
Promotions & Discounts

Create promotional campaigns and discounts to attract customers, clear inventory, and boost sales during special occasions.

Types of Promotions

Create various types of promotions:

  • Percentage discounts
  • Fixed amount discounts
  • Buy X Get Y offers
  • Free shipping
  • Flash sales
  • Seasonal promotions
  • Bundle deals
  • Clearance sales

Creating a Promotion

Step 1: Access Promotions

Navigate to Marketing → Promotions and click "Create Promotion".

Step 2: Set Promotion Details

Configure promotion:

  • Promotion name
  • Discount type and amount
  • Start and end dates
  • Applicable products
  • Usage limits

Step 3: Configure Rules

Set promotion rules:

  • Minimum order amount
  • Maximum discount
  • Product restrictions
  • Customer restrictions

Step 4: Activate

Activate the promotion. It will be automatically applied during checkout.

Flash Sales

Create time-limited flash sales:

  • Set short duration (hours or days)
  • Create urgency
  • Promote heavily
  • Limited quantity options

Seasonal Promotions

Plan seasonal campaigns:

  • Holiday sales
  • Back-to-school
  • Summer sales
  • Black Friday
  • Cyber Monday
  • End of season clearance

Bundle Deals

Create product bundles:

  • Buy multiple items together
  • Special bundle pricing
  • Related product suggestions
  • Cross-sell opportunities

Promotion Display

Show promotions to customers:

  • Homepage banners
  • Product page badges
  • Category page highlights
  • Email campaigns
  • Social media

Promotion Analytics

Track promotion performance:

  • Sales generated
  • Conversion rates
  • Revenue impact
  • Customer acquisition
  • ROI

Best Practices

  • Plan promotions in advance
  • Create urgency with time limits
  • Promote across channels
  • Monitor performance
  • Don't overuse promotions
  • Test different offers
  • Track ROI
